Contents

Lab Overview

Lab Overview

In this lab you will install and run the Period Close Agent for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance. The agent runs on the Microsoft Copilot harness and works from the live closing schedule in the Financial period close workspace. It reads the close plan, starts the tasks it is authorised to run, carries out the work in Finance and operations through the Dynamics 365 ERP MCP server, records an audit trail and sends governed close communications.

The agent separates how it works from what the business wants. Built-in agent skills hold the fixed procedures (retrieving the plan, gating execution, changing task status, sending email), while business skills stored in Dataverse hold the finance policy for each close task, such as thresholds, account scope or the SharePoint export location. Finance owners can change or add business skills without editing the agent itself, which is what Part 3 of this lab explores.

By the end of this lab you will be able to:

Architecture at a Glance

Architecture at a Glance

The Period Close Agent is a Copilot Studio agent that orchestrates the close. It never edits Finance and operations data directly; every read and write goes through a governed tool, and every task status change goes through a dedicated Power Automate flow.

LayerComponentWhat it does
AgentPeriod Close Agent (Microsoft Copilot harness)Classifies each request, decides which tasks may run, controls task status and summarises the run. Published to Microsoft Teams and Microsoft 365 Copilot.
Built-in agent skills13 skills, for example retrieve-close-plan, execute-period-close-task, run-close-task-chain, import-journal-from-csvFixed procedures the agent always follows. They cannot be widened by a business skill.
Business skills13 Dataverse skills named PeriodClose_*Finance policy per close task, read at run time through the Dataverse MCP Server. Seven run close tasks, three describe journal imports and three support email and reporting.
Dynamics 365 ERP MCPFin & Ops Apps (Dynamics 365) connectorLive reads and writes in Finance and operations: closing schedule, journals, fixed assets, trial balance and more.
Dataverse MCP ServerMicrosoft Dataverse connectorReads the PeriodClose_* business skills.
SharePoint and Mail MCPSharePoint (Work IQ) and Outlook Mail MCPReads journal CSV files, writes trial balance exports and sends close emails.
Power Automate flows6 flows prefixed PCAMark task started, Mark task completed, Record task audit, Retrieve close plan, plus two triggers that start the agent when a task is completed or started by a person.
DataversePeriod Close Task Audit table and Period Close Compliance Review appStores one audit record per task attempt for compliance review.

Two settings on each closing schedule task control what the agent does:

Part 1 — Install and Configure the Period Close Agent

Step 1 — Verify the Agent Enabled Field

The Agent enabled field on closing schedule tasks controls which tasks the agent may run. Your lab administrator has enabled the Period Close Agent capability; check that the field is available.

NOTE: Showing the column is only for you. The closing schedule tasks data entity always includes the Agent enabled field, so the agent reads it whether or not the column is visible in the grid.
NOTE: If Agent enabled is not offered in Insert columns, the Period Close Agent capability is not enabled in your environment. Contact your lab facilitator before continuing.
NOTE: Production use is gated and controlled by Microsoft. Microsoft enables the Period Close Agent capability for production environments on request; register through https://aka.ms/PeriodCloseAgentSignUp. Step 11 — Turn On the Agent Flows

The solution contains six Power Automate flows. Four are called by the agent as tools and are turned on during import. The two flows that react to changes on the closing schedule are imported turned off, and you turn them on in this step.

FlowStarted byWhat it does
PCA - Retrieve informational close planThe agent (tool)Reads the closing schedule tasks for a legal entity and schedule and returns the close plan with due-date metrics
PCA - Mark task startedThe agent (tool)Sets a closing schedule task to In progress in Finance
PCA - Mark task completedThe agent (tool)Sets a closing schedule task to Completed in Finance
PCA - Record task auditThe agent (tool)Writes one record per task attempt to the Period Close Task Audit table
PCA - Auto-run tasks on completionA task is completedStarts the agent so it can continue with the next #autostart task
PCA - Run human-started taskA person starts an Agent enabled taskStarts the agent to run that task

Part 3 — Extend the Agent with Your Own Business Skill

Part 3 — Extend the Agent with Your Own Business Skill

Business skills hold the finance policy for each close task. Because the agent reads them from Dataverse at run time, a finance owner can change a rule or add a new task type without editing or republishing the agent. In Part 3 you look at how a skill is built, add a new one and run it.

Part 3 — Extend the Agent with Your Own Business Skill

Step 15 — Understand How a Business Skill Is Built

Open PeriodClose_FixedAssetDepreciation on the Business skills (preview) page and read it alongside the table below. Every PeriodClose_ task skill follows the same layout.

SectionWhat it doesExample: fixed asset depreciation skill
Name and descriptionThe name starts with PeriodClose_. The description tells the agent when to use the skill and what to exclude.Matches fixed asset depreciation, monthly depreciation or depreciation proposal tasks; excludes acquisition, disposal and posting
ClassificationDeclares the kind of procedure, the posting policy and the execution modes the agent may use.task-execution, DraftOnly, Batch only
Routing contractThe words the task name must contain for the skill to be chosen.FA depreciation, monthly depreciation, depreciation proposal
Required data sourceThe only tool the skill may use, and what to do if it fails.Dynamics 365 ERP MCP; the Fixed asset journal list for the precheck
ScopeWhich legal entity, dates and records are in scope.One legal entity and one period; unfiltered unless the task names a book or asset group
Policy (edit to change)The finance rules a business owner tunes.Proposal date rule, precheck and batch task description
ReportThe layout of the answer.Period, proposal date, journal name, batch description and responsible person
Business outcomeExactly one outcome, chosen by ordered rules.Started successfully, Blocked by unposted journals, or Submission blocked
Ground rulesHard limits the agent must respect.Never posts; never touches a journal it did not create
NOTE: The description is what the agent reads first when it looks for a skill, so it must say clearly which task names the skill matches and what it excludes. Sections marked edit to change the policy are meant for finance owners; the rest is the contract the agent relies on.

Step 20 — Create Your Own Skill

Files for this step

You can write a business skill for any close task you want the agent to run. Start from PeriodClose_SkillTemplate.md in the Business skill folder of the lab package, or select Create skill on the Business skills (preview) page and write it there.

TIP: The fastest way to a working skill is to copy a shipped skill that does similar work, for example PeriodClose_VendorAgingReview for a review or PeriodClose_IFRS16JournalEntry for a SharePoint journal import, and change only the routing contract and the policy sections.
Part 3 — Extend the Agent with Your Own Business Skill

How Skills Align with the Closing Schedule

The agent has no task list of its own. It works from the closing schedule in the Financial period close workspace, and each task setting has a job:

Closing schedule settingHow the agent uses itWhat it means for your skill
Task nameMatched against the routing contract of every active skill to choose oneUse the same words in the task name and in the routing contract
AreaConfirms the match and, for shared names such as Currency revaluation, selects the moduleState the expected Area, but never rely on Area alone
Agent enabledThe only setting that allows the agent to run the taskNothing: a skill can never override it
#autostart in the nameLets the agent continue to the task when the previous task completesKeep #autostart out of the routing words
Task linkThe form or process the task opens, for example VendExchAdjName the same menu item in the skill
Dependencies (Blocked)The agent never runs a blocked taskNothing: complete the predecessor tasks first
Due dateUsed for overdue and approaching-due reports and for due #autostart runsNothing
ResponsibleReceives the review hand-off and email; needs an email addressNothing
Closing schedule periodSupplies the period and end date to the runBase the date policy on the period, usually its last day

To use your skill every month, add the task to the closing template as well: in Financial period close configuration, open the template (for example Month end) and add the task with the same name, area, task link, closing role and due date. Every new monthly schedule created from the template then includes it. After you create each new schedule, check Agent enabled on the tasks the agent should run.

Appendix B — Troubleshooting and Known Issues

Appendix B — Troubleshooting and Known Issues

These issues were seen while the lab was tested.

What you seeLikely causeWhat to do
The review email is not sent and the audit record shows Failed with UnresolvedRecipientThe Responsible worker on the task has no email addressSet Responsible to a worker with an email address in their worker record (Step 5)
The agent says the task is blockedA predecessor task is not complete: Blocked (dependency)Complete the predecessor tasks. The agent never skips a dependency
The agent refuses to read a journal fileThe skill still names the original SharePoint site, or the folder or file name differsRepeat Step 12 and check the folders against Step 7
Creating the closing schedule fails with Unable to find any working timesThe working-time calendar does not cover the periodCreate a calendar that covers 2026 and 2027 (Step 5)
The close plan lists one task fewer than the workspaceThe Global Controller marker task is used to find email recipients, not as a close taskNo action needed
A revaluation or depreciation batch job ends with ErrorThe batch process failed after the agent handed it overOpen the job log in System administration > Inquiries > Batch jobs. The task stays In progress until a person resolves it
The agent says no business skill matches the taskThe task name lacks the routing words, the skill is inactive, or two active skills matchCheck the task name, make sure the skill is Active and that only one skill matches
